about.title: About Us
about.sub: We help patients across Sri Lanka find the right doctor, book a real appointment and access their lab reports — simply and securely.
about.story1: Healthcare should be easy to reach. Our platform brings doctors, clinics and laboratories together so patients spend less time waiting and more time getting care.
about.story2: MediFlow is built for patients in every district, in Sinhala, Tamil and English.
about.imgAlt: A nurse helping an elderly patient in a clinic
about.missionText: To make booking trusted doctors and receiving medical results simple, transparent and secure for every patient.
about.visionText: A connected healthcare experience where every patient, in any language, can reach the care they need.
about.o1t: Search by specialty, hospital and location.
about.o3t: Secure download with a one-time code.
about.o4t: Appointments and reports in one place.

legal.privacyIntro: This policy explains how MediFlow collects, uses and protects your personal and medical information.
legal.p1: Your name, mobile number or email, appointment details and lab reports uploaded by your doctor or laboratory.
legal.p2: Only to book and manage appointments, send one-time sign-in codes and deliver your reports. We never sell personal data.
legal.p3: Access is restricted by role at the database level. Lab reports are stored privately and shared only through short-lived secure links after a one-time code is verified.
legal.p4: You can request a copy or deletion of your data by contacting support.
legal.placeholder: [Placeholder — have this policy reviewed by a legal professional before launch.]
legal.termsIntro: By using MediFlow you agree to these terms.
legal.t1: A booking reserves a specific time slot with a doctor. Please arrive 15 minutes early with your reference number.
legal.t2: You can cancel or reschedule an upcoming appointment from your dashboard before it starts.
legal.t3: MediFlow is a booking platform and does not provide medical advice. In an emergency call 1990 (Suwa Seriya).
legal.t4: You're responsible for keeping access to your phone or email secure, as one-time codes are sent there.
